description: Several ChatGPT logins for the Microsoft Store Codex app on Windows. The account list lives in Codex's own avatar menu (switch, add, rename, remove); a CLI (CodexAccounts.ps1) does the same for agents. One saved auth.json per account, chats and settings in ~/.codex are shared. Use for Codex multi-account, wrong-account, switch-account or "account menu missing" questions.
